Delayed response times and lack of systematic follow-ups for incoming inquiries.

what_this_data_cannot_tell_us: The exact qualitative reasons why un-converted leads chose competitors over Axeom.

monday_top_3: Reach out to high-priority un-converted leads with a re-engagement offer.
